name: STIRRED WATER BATH
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Stirred Water Bath combines the functions of a precision liquid incubator and a mechanical stirrer. It is widely used in chemical extraction, distillation, enzymatic research labs, and sample warmings where constant temperature uniformity is critical. Equipped with an electric stirrer for water recirculation and a precision PID controller, it guarantees exceptional temperature stability across the entire liquid reservoir while keeping your samples in a consistent environment.
features: Precise stirring control with an independent stirrer on/off switch
Digital PID temperature controller with bright LED display
Exceptional water temperature stability and uniform distribution
ISI marked immersion heater for safe and fast heating
Durable double wall construction with 5-sided glass wool insulation

specifications.Temperature Display: Dual LED display of SV & PV
specifications.Stirrer Type: Heavy duty motor with paddle & blade (Variable Speed)
